 Advertisement Updated: 6:43 PM EST Nov 7, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Brooke Silverang WPBF 25 First Warning Meteorologist Big cold front for South Florida
 Updated: 6:43 PM EST Nov 7, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Brooke Silverang WPBF 25 First Warning Meteorologist Temps will fall to the 70s for the Palm Beach overnight and the 60s for the Treasure Coast. High temps will reach the low to mid 80s on Sunday. A stronger cold front moves through by the end of the week bringing in the coldest air we’ve seen since winter.
